final_prompt:
Create a Europa Universalis V UI icon for the Standard of Living mod.
Subject: A shared Standard of Living icon: a small balance scale holding a coin on one side and grain or bread on the other, with a subtle warm glow suggesting household prosperity and daily consumption.
Use a compact painterly strategy-game icon style with a readable centered silhouette.
It must work as one shared icon for a situation entry, a map mode, and a small location-window button.
Do not include text, letters, numbers, watermarks, logos, UI frames, or a large narrative scene.
Final DDS target: 128x128, DXT5, <= 100,000 bytes.
Target requirements: This is not a large illustration. It is a single shared SOL UI icon for the situation list, mapmode selector, and location-window shortcut button. Make it simple, centered, circular-friendly, and readable after downscaling.
Style rules: Match EU5's compact painterly interface icon language: restrained contrast, warm metal highlights, soft hand-painted edges, and a clean readable center shape.
Composition rules: The icon must read clearly at 38px and 128px. Prefer one central balance-scale or household-prosperity symbol with a small coin and grain accent. Keep empty margin around the silhouette.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, UI frame, logo, watermark, busy market scene, crowd, large landscape, realistic photo, modern objects, charts, graphs, flags
